basis: Employer super guarantee contributions for qualifying earnings paid from 1 July 2026 (Payday Super). The latest day a contribution can be received under SGAA 1992 s 18C(1)(c)(i) and the applicable items of the s 18C(2) table.

usual.basis: SGAA 1992 s 6(1) 'usual period': starts on the QE day and ends on the seventh business day after it.

item_1.basis: SGAA 1992 s 18C(2) item 1 and s 6(1) 'extended usual period': the first eligible contribution to a fund or RSA after the employee commenced or recommenced, or after the employer ceased contributing to another fund or RSA; ends on the 20th business day after the QE day.

item_2.basis: SGAA 1992 s 18C(2) item 2 and LI 2026/20 (F2026L00784) s 5: out-of-cycle qualifying earnings; the usual period of the first standard QE day after the current QE day.

item_3.basis: SGAA 1992 s 18C(2) item 3 and s 18C(4): a determination for exceptional circumstances; the later of the extended usual period and 20 business days starting on the day after the determination is made.

item_4.basis: SGAA 1992 s 18C(2) item 4: the latest due day of an earlier eligible contribution made and applied for an earlier QE day.

business_day: SGAA 1992 s 6(1): any day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a public holiday for the whole of any State, the ACT or the NT.

calendar.horizon_note: Victoria's 2027 Friday before the AFL Grand Final is not yet published, so no count may pass 31 August 2027.
calendar.excluded: Part-day holidays: 7pm to midnight on 24 and 31 December in SA (Public Holidays Act 2023 (SA) s 4) and the NT (Public Holidays Act 1981 (NT) s 5 and Schedule 2), and 6pm to midnight on 24 December in Queensland; these make part of the day a public holiday, not the day. Also excluded: regional holidays (show days, Royal Queensland Show, Tasmanian regional days), Melbourne Cup Day (in 2026 Greater Geelong, Warrnambool and other non-metropolitan councils substituted a local day), WA King's Birthday 2026 (Karratha and Port Hedland observed 3 August 2026 instead), Tasmania's Easter Tuesday (generally the Tasmanian Public Service only) and the NSW and ACT Bank Holiday (not a public holiday for everyone). Weekend holidays need no row.

weekday_holidays.name: Friday before the AFL Grand Final
Boxing Day or its additional day; Proclamation Day additional day
Canberra Day; Adelaide Cup Day; Eight Hours Day; Labour Day
ANZAC Day additional or observed day

limits: Preparation aid requiring professional review; it does not decide whether a contribution was on time or assess the super guarantee charge.

Every extension is caller-supplied: whether a contribution is the first to a fund, whether earnings are out-of-cycle under LI 2026/20, whether a determination covers the employer and QE day, and whether an earlier eligible contribution was made and applied for an earlier QE day are not verified.
An extension the caller does not supply is not applied: omitting one can make the result earlier than the law allows, never later.

A contribution counts only if received with the information the fund needs to allocate it; amounts, the order of application, the 12-month pre-payment window in s 18C(1)(c)(ii) and the shortfall are not computed.
Defined benefit interests (s 18A(3)) and constitutionally protected funds are outside scope.
Holidays declared or moved after the calendar check date are not reflected.
